mxCell.value: Storage model: In-memory (sync.RWMutex maps). Events published to Kafka / Lakehouse. Customer profiles synced from user-service.

Customer ---------------------- customer_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) rm_id (FK -> RelationshipManager) first_name / last_name (varchar) email / phone (varchar) customer_type (varchar: retail/sme/corporate) segment (varchar: mass/premium/private) kyc_status / kyc_tier (varchar) account_ids ([]varchar) total_aum (int64) credit_score (int) onboarded_at / last_review_at (timestamp) status (varchar: active/dormant/exited) created_at / updated_at

Portfolio ---------------------- portfolio_id (varchar) rm_id (FK -> RelationshipManager) tenant_id (varchar) customer_ids ([]varchar) total_customers (int) total_aum (int64) total_deposits / total_loans (int64) npl_ratio (float) revenue_ytd (int64) target_aum / target_revenue (int64) performance_score (float) updated_at

Opportunity ---------------------- opportunity_id (varchar) customer_id (FK -> Customer) rm_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) opportunity_type (varchar: loan/investment/insurance/fx) title / description (varchar) estimated_value (int64) probability (float) stage (varchar: prospect/qualified/proposal/negotiation/closed_won/closed_lost) expected_close_date (date) product_id / product_name (varchar) notes (text) created_at / updated_at

Activity ---------------------- activity_id (varchar) customer_id (FK -> Customer) rm_id / tenant_id (varchar) activity_type (varchar: call/meeting/email/visit/review) subject / notes (text) outcome (varchar) next_action (varchar) next_action_date (date) duration_minutes (int) scheduled_at / completed_at (timestamp) status (varchar: planned/completed/cancelled) created_at

Campaign ---------------------- campaign_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) name / description (varchar) campaign_type (varchar: product/retention/acquisition) target_segment (varchar) target_product (varchar) start_date / end_date (date) target_customers (int) reached_customers (int) converted_customers (int) status (varchar: draft/active/paused/completed) created_by / created_at
